messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] can't install latest rstan!
parts:
When the install script (`install_rstan`) calls `install.packages`, RStudio might prompt for whether you'd like to restart R prior to installing. When the user chooses the default option ("yes"), then R restarts and the packages install, but the rest of the script doesn't execute. Hence rstan isn't installed.

This happened to me initially, and I'd bet it's what happened to Andrew above (note that in his logs we see the result of install.packages("Rcpp", type = "source")but no output from the install script after that).

One option is to tell users to say "no" when they're asked about restarting R. I don't know if there are other/better options.

I haven't worked out exactly what conditions trigger the prompt to restart, but it's connected with whether the package is currently loaded. https://support.rstudio.com/hc/communities/public/questions/200652636-Suppress-restart-dialog-on-Loaded-Package-Install
